trust_decision.summary: The MP4 atom walkers trust the 32/64-bit atom size field read from the file to advance the read position; sizes smaller than the header yield zero/negative advances (e.g. seek back onto the same header). The fix centralises header decoding in _read_atom_header and stops parsing when size < header size.

landing_point.why: Summary says 'M4A files containing invalid atoms'; _MP4._traverse_atoms is the obvious main atom walker.

fix_sites.entry_point: TinyTag.get(...) on .m4a/.mp4 or ftyp-magic file (tinytag/tinytag.py:119); CLI python -m tinytag
fix_sites.module_kind: core parser (atom header decode + loop condition; fix.diff:250-300)
core parser (versioned/flagged atom skip guarded by size, fix.diff:325-331)

fix_sites.entry_point: TinyTag.get(..., tags=True), unknown atom under moov/udta/meta/ilst
fix_sites.module_kind: core parser (re-seek by fixed 8 bytes ignores 64-bit header; fix.diff:363-371)
core parser (stop_pos check moved to tracked position, fix.diff:380-383)

fix_sites.entry_point: TinyTag.get(..., tags=True), '----' freeform atom in ilst (tree leaf tinytag/tinytag.py:590)
fix_sites.module_kind: second atom walker over in-memory BytesIO (fix.diff:445-455)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: tinytag/tinytag.py:735-760 (_MP4._parse_custom_field re-walks child atoms of '----' with its own loop; atom_size = size-8 can be negative and fh.seek at :759 then rewinds onto the same header)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: It parses an in-memory bytes slice already bounded by the outer walker, so a solver may assume the outer fix bounds it; but it is same-file, same-class and a few dozen lines below the landing point.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Atoms with size 1 (64-bit extended size) must keep parsing; valid files whose freeform/ilst children follow empty atoms must still yield tags; an over-broad fix raising ParseError on any odd size would break existing samples such as mp4_size_zero.m4a (expected filesize/mime only).

O6_input_shapes: 64-bit extended size (size==1) with ext size smaller than 16 or truncated ext header
versioned/flagged atoms (meta, stsd) with payload < 4 bytes
unknown ilst atom with 64-bit header (re-seek by fixed 8)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: WAV LIST/INFO sub-walker over BytesIO, could plausibly use a signed/size-minus-header length like the MP4 custom-field walker
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Same 'walk sub-chunks of an in-memory chunk' idiom as _parse_custom_field; currently unsigned and forward-only, so a sibling would have to be planted.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: ASF object walker subtracting header_len from object size, currently clamped with max(...,0)
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Removing or misplacing the clamp would recreate the same size-minus-header bug in a different format class.

O9_family: CWE-835 infinite loop / unbounded parse loop from untrusted length field (resource exhaustion)

O10_build.toolchain: pure Python (>=3.7 typing via __future__), pytest/unittest; no native deps
O10_build.project_tests: tinytag/tests/test_all.py (TEST_FILES table incl. mp4 samples e.g. mp4_size_zero.m4a at :1919), tinytag/tests/test_cli.py

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Change 'if atom_size <= 0' in _traverse_atoms to break instead of continue, leaving the 64-bit/ilst re-seek and the _parse_custom_field walker open.
